entry.title: ECBD: a review
entry.summary: A review of ECBD, a framework for constructing benchmarks taken from educational testing. I used it to formalise a benchmark on professional work.

entry.title: GDPval: a review
entry.summary: A review of OpenAI's GDPval, an expert-authored benchmark on economically valuable work. Running the rubrics turned up 4 bugs in 15 tasks.

entry.title: Suitesmith: environment + training run
entry.summary: An RL environment which trains a model to write test suites for functions which operate on structured data. 20 steps of GRPO took a 4B from 0.41 to 0.88.
